note: Ranked lists made by other people, shown on the Models page with their age. Each list says who ranked it and how; Potluck has not measured these rankings. A list past its expiry date is shown folded away as out of date. tools/catalog.py copies this file into models.json.

lists.title: Uncensored models tier list
lists.by: A community tier list shared on X
lists.about: Open models with their refusals removed (abliterated, heretic or trained uncensored), ranked on how much ability they kept, how often they are downloaded and what people actually run. S is best. Potluck checks each model's sizes against your computers when you open it.

items.name: Qwen3.8-27B Abliterated
items.note: The most downloaded uncensored model on Hugging Face; the usual first choice.

items.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Uncensored
items.note: Very large (748B) mixture-of-experts with vision; needs many computers.

items.name: GLM-5.3 Abliterated
items.note: Top of the uncensored intelligence rankings; refusals cut from 90% to 3%.

items.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B Uncensored
items.note: Only 3B parameters work per word, so it is fast; strong at tools and agent work.

items.name: Gemma 4 12B Heretic
items.note: Best for small graphics cards; reported 99 refusals down to 0 with little quality lost (KL 0.028).

items.name: Kimi K2.6 Abliterated Heretic
items.note: 1T-parameter mixture-of-experts with vision; needs a rack of computers.

items.name: Hermes 4.3 36B
items.note: Trained without refusals rather than edited afterwards; long context.

items.name: Mistral Small 3.2 Abliterated
items.note: A favourite for fiction and role-play, on an older base.

items.name: Gemma 4 26B-A4B Abliterated
items.note: Fast for its quality on modest graphics cards.

items.name: Qwen3.5-9B Heretic
items.note: Best quality under 8 GB (KL 0.08).

items.name: Qwen3.5-4B Uncensored (HauhauCS)
items.note: For computers without a graphics card; about 3 GB (KL 0.02).

items.name: Gemma 4 E4B Heretic
items.note: Runs in 5 GB: phones and old laptops.

items.name: MiniMax M3
items.note: Unfiltered through MiniMax's paid service; no version to run at home yet.

items.name: Llama 3.3 70B Abliterated
items.note: Still sharp, but needs about 40 GB and its base is old.

items.name: Dolphin 3
items.note: Coherent fine-tune, but its bases are two generations old.

items.name: Venice Uncensored 1.2
items.note: Built on Dolphin; fine, not leading.

items.name: Llama 3.1 8B Abliterated
items.note: The old starting point everyone began with.

items.name: Gemma 4 E2B
items.note: Runs anywhere, but it is not clever.

items.name: Huihui Qwen3.5-4B Abliterated
items.note: Badly damaged by the edit (KL 3.65): avoid.

items.name: Dolphin 1.x / 2.x on Llama 3.1
items.note: First-generation edits, replaced by 2026 retrains.

items.name: Llama 2 fine-tunes / Vicuna
items.note: Still in 2026 listicles; three generations behind.

items.name: Any "uncensored" model with no KL number
items.note: If the model page does not say how much quality the edit cost, skip it.
